Personal website of Dhruba — working on AI agents and developer tools.

## Current Work

- [Voiden](https://voiden.md) — A Git-native API client. Collections are Markdown files. Offline-first, no account required. By ApyHub.

## Previous Work

- [Cua](https://cua.so) — YC X25. AI agents that interact with computers through the screen—clicking, typing, navigating. Led community and content, helping reach 2 million+ impressions on Reddit. (Apr – Dec 2025)

- Research at Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science — Master's in Computer Science. Worked on fact verification and interpretability.

## Writing
